title: Extraction with Mag-Bind TotalPure NGS kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Cold reagents added to sample r1-r3
Room temperature non viscous reagents are added to sample tr1-tr6
Room temperature viscous reagents are added to sample tr7-tr9

steps.title: Add cold reagents
steps.instruction: Using the P20 single‑channel pipette (mounted on the specified left/right mount), dispense the cold reagents (RR1‑TR3) into samples r1‑r3. Use the RR1‑TR10 Volume parameter for each reagent.

steps.title: Add room‑temp non‑viscous reagents
steps.instruction: Using the P20 pipette (as mounted), add the room‑temperature non‑viscous reagents (RR1‑TR6) to samples tr1‑tr6, each at the volume defined by the RR1‑TR10 Volume parameter.

steps.title: Add room‑temp viscous reagents
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel pipette (mounted on the specified left/right mount), dispense the room‑temperature viscous reagents (RR1‑TR7‑TR9) into samples tr7‑tr9 at the RR1‑TR10 Volume for each.

steps.title: Incubate and mix
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples for two hours, mixing every 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add final viscous reagent
steps.instruction: Add the final viscous reagent (tr10) to each sample using the P300 pipette and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Transfer to magnetic plate
steps.instruction: Move all samples from their current rack to the magnetic plate on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Prepare and add magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend magnetic beads in the Mag Bead Resuspend Volume, mixing the specified Mag Bead Resuspend Mix Repetitions. Split the total bead volume equally among the Number of Mag Bead Tubes (column 6 of the room‑temperature reagent rack). Then add the appropriate bead volume to each sample.

steps.title: Engage magnet and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Activate the magnetic module to engage the magnet, allow beads to collect, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Perform ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Conduct two sequential ethanol washes: add ethanol to each well, let beads remain on the magnet, then remove and discard the ethanol each time.

steps.title: Add water
steps.instruction: Add the specified volume of water (as defined by RR1‑TR10 Volume) to each sample to elute the RNA.

steps.title: Transfer to final rack
steps.instruction: Move the eluate from each well to the final tube rack for downstream use.
